create_cql_config_with_defaults: create a CQLConfig instance using all default values for batch size, learning rates, and discount
customize_cql_batch_size: create a CQLConfig with a custom batch_size of 512 for larger training batches
configure_adaptive_cql_coefficient: create a CQLConfig with fixed_cql_coefficient set to None to enable adaptive coefficient mode
set_entropy_coefficient: create a CQLConfig with a fixed_entropy_coefficient value to disable adaptive entropy bonus
configure_bc_initialization: create a CQLConfig with custom num_bc_iters to control behavior cloning steps for actor initialization
